instruction: Change the font to Calibri for all text in the document.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing font to Calibri for all text. Uses existing compare_font_names metric which verifies all runs have the expected font name.
